title: AAPS 3.3.x and Libre 2/3 identifier sent from Xdrip
symptom: With AAPS 3.3.x, SMB cannot be enabled for Libre 2 & 3 because AAPS reports 'active BG source doesn't support advanced filtering.' The issue is that xDrip sends an incorrect identifier for Libre sensors, such as LIBRE_1_OTHER or LIBRE_1_LIMMITER, instead of the expected 'Libre2', 'Libre2 Native', or 'Libre3'.
cause: xDrip sends an incorrect source identifier in the broadcast to AAPS. AAPS expects 'Libre2', 'Libre2 Native', or 'Libre3' in com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip.Extras.SourceInfo, but xDrip sends identifiers like LIBRE_1_OTHER or LIBRE_1_LIMMITER (as seen in AAPS logs).
fix: Update xDrip to send the correct identifiers ('Libre2', 'Libre2 Native', or 'Libre3') in the SourceInfo broadcast. This was reportedly fixed in a nightly commit (f6bd8e58c921c585f198e96ce14482fa7019e097). Users should also upgrade to the latest AAPS 3.3.1.3 to include the 'Libre2 Native' identifier.
evidence_quote: AAPS expects `Libre2` or `Libre2 Native` or `Libre3` in `com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip.Extras.SourceInfo` to be able to properly identify Libre 2 or 3 for full SMB support in AAPS 3.3
